messages:
elaine: Quick 18h run for Sentinel-13b comparing int8 vs int6 tuned. Mixed slices: long-QA, multi-par summarization, short replies. Short score + routing recs below.

elaine: TL;DR: int6 ~18% token savings, better p50 for short calls, but ~3.8pp drop on multi-span QA exact-match. Summaries stable.

mike: sample sizes + cost numbers?

elaine: 12k samples (6k long-QA, 4k summaries, 2k shorts). Unit econ proxy: int8=$0.0094/k, int6=$0.0077/k (-18%). p50 latency int8 465ms -> int6 410ms. p95 +2.5% for int6.

sara: how measured QA drop? priming sensitivity?

elaine: span exact-match on long-QA slice. priming sweep shows int6 worse with 3-5 shot templates and concat length >900 tokens (kvcache noise).

raj: paste compact scorecard pls

elaine: metric | int8 | int6 | delta
unit_cost($/k) | 0.0094 | 0.0077 | -18%
p50_latency(ms) | 465 | 410 | -12%
p95_latency(ms) | 1015 | 1040 | +2.5%
longQA_exact(%) | 79.0 | 75.2 | -3.8pp
throughput(tok/s) | 2150 | 2340 | +9%

sara: recommendation for product?

elaine: routing proposal: default int8. Allow int6 for caller-hinted short generators: feature_hint={"feature":"summary","est_out":<250}. Guards: if examples_count>=2 OR concat_context>900 OR feature_hint in ["doc-qa","rerank"] -> force int8. Canary: 10% eligible short-gen traffic for 48h, monitor exact-match by slice, ROUGE for summaries, CTR, cost delta.

raj: ops: add canary ticket and dashboard; watch p95 and failing-query capture.

ops-bot: Canary ticket created: ML-6210 (sentinel-int6-canary) - 5100012600

mike: action items: (1) eng-platform implement routing + priming-guard (2) observability: canary dashboard + failing-query snapshot (3) product: SDK feature_hint + opt-in.

elaine: I'll upload the small CSV of borderline failures to the eng-ml drive and follow up with runbook.
